name: extract_read_sources
command:
import os,resource; os.sched_setaffinity(0,sorted(os.sched_getaffinity(0))[:2]); resource.setrlimit(resource.RLIMIT_CPU,(115,115)); resource.setrlimit(resource.RLIMIT_AS,(6*1024**3,6*1024**3));
from pathlib import Path
import subprocess
lane=Path.cwd()
for name in ['curves','digits']:
 r=subprocess.run(['pdftotext','-layout',f'sources/{name}.pdf','-'],capture_output=True,text=True);assert r.returncode==0
 w=subprocess.run(['python3','-I','-B',str(lane/'write_lane.py'),f'sources/{name}.txt'],input=r.stdout,capture_output=True,text=True);assert w.returncode==0
 print(name,'chars',len(r.stdout));print(r.stdout if name=='curves' else r.stdout[-20000:])
